_comment: The faked live half of the `serial --json` contract for canon_multi_mcu.cfg.
detect.scan() and detect.all_identities() are the only two calls the CLI
layer makes to the machine, and a byte-golden must not depend on what is
plugged into this Mac today, so both are answered from this file: no port is
opened, no ioreg runs, the bench SKR Pico is never reset. `attached` is the
node list macOS would report; `identities` is one detect.identity() dict per
node, in detect's own shape ('key' = 'usb:<vid>:<pid>:<USB serial>').
